content: We use the CFILT-preorder system for reordering English sentences to match the Indian language word order. It contains two re-ordering systems: (1) generic rules that apply to all Indian languages BIBREF17 , and (2) hindi-tuned rules which improve the generic rules by incorporating improvements found through an error analysis of English-Hindi reordering BIBREF28 . These Hindi-tuned rules have been found to improve reordering for many English to Indian language pairs BIBREF29 .
